# Summary

Run: **`r params$run`**

Number of samples run:  **`r params$n_samples`**

Input type: **`r switch(params$input_type, "fasta" = "Consensus sequences (FASTA)", "long-read" = "Long-read sequencing (FASTQ)", "Short-read sequencing (FASTQ)")`**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(gt)
library(htmltools)

is_fasta <- params$input_type == "fasta"

# Shared footnote text for the Confidence column, matching the per-sample report.
confidence_footnote_text <- paste(
  "Confidence reflects how well-supported a call is, independent of resistance level",
  "(worst tier across every sample/detection contributing to this row) - see the per-sample report for the full definition.",
  "No call is filtered out based on this - it's for triage, not a hard cutoff."
)
```

```{r confidence_overview}
# Quick per-sample triage: how many detected resistance mutations in each
# sample fall into each confidence tier (see the per-sample report for what
# High/Medium/Low mean). Sorted so samples with Low-confidence findings are
# easy to spot; this never filters anything, just flags where to look first.
confidence_overview_df <- NULL
if (!is_fasta) {
  resistance_files_for_confidence <- list.files(pattern = "\\.resistance\\.tsv$")
  if (length(resistance_files_for_confidence) > 0) {
    confidence_raw <- resistance_files_for_confidence |>
      purrr::map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) |>
          mutate(Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))))
      )
    if (nrow(confidence_raw) > 0 && "confidence" %in% names(confidence_raw)) {
      confidence_overview_df <- confidence_raw |>
        filter(confidence != "N/A") |>
        distinct(Sample, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, confidence) |>
        count(Sample, confidence) |>
        pivot_wider(names_from = confidence, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
        select(Sample, any_of(c("High", "Medium", "Low")))
      if ("Low" %in% names(confidence_overview_df)) {
        confidence_overview_df <- confidence_overview_df |> arrange(desc(Low))
      }
    }
  }
}
```

`r if (!is.null(confidence_overview_df)) "## Confidence overview" else ""`

`r if (!is.null(confidence_overview_df)) "How many detected resistance mutations in each sample fall into each confidence tier - see the per-sample report for what High/Medium/Low mean. This is a triage signal, not a filter: every finding still appears in full in its sample report regardless of tier." else ""`

```{r confidence_overview_table}
if (!is.null(confidence_overview_df)) {
  tbl_conf <- confidence_overview_df |> gt() |>
    tab_options(table.font.size = if (!knitr::is_html_output()) "8pt" else "100%")
  if ("Low" %in% names(confidence_overview_df)) {
    tbl_conf <- tbl_conf |>
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_fill(color = "#FFB6C1"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
        locations = cells_body(columns = Low, rows = Low > 0)
      )
  }
  tbl_conf
}
```

```{r genotype_analysis}
# Strain genotyping (e.g. UL55/gB) - independent of resistance-mutation
# calling. run_genotypes is empty unless a --genotype_* flag was set.
run_genotypes_df <- NULL
if (nzchar(params$run_genotypes) && file.exists(params$run_genotypes)) {
  run_genotypes_df <- read_tsv(params$run_genotypes, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    rename(
      Sample = sample,
      Gene = gene,
      Genotype = genotype,
      `Region covered` = region_covered,
      `Match confidence` = match_confidence,
      Notes = notes
    )
}
```

```{r}
# FASTQ input: per-gene coverage/depth from samtools coverage.
# FASTA input: per-gene "was a consensus record assessed?" from the differ.
coverage_df <- NULL
assessed_df <- NULL

if (!is_fasta) {
  coverage_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.coverage\\.tsv$")
  coverage_df <- coverage_files |>
      map_dfr(
          ~read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
              mutate(
                  Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                      tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
                  )
              )
      )
} else {
  assessed_files <- list.files(pattern = "\\.assessed\\.tsv$")
  assessed_df <- assessed_files |>
      map_dfr(~read_tsv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
# Per-sample x gene overview: which gene regions had a consensus record, and
# how well it aligned to the reference.
if (is_fasta) {
  if (is.null(assessed_df) || nrow(assessed_df) == 0) {
    cat("No consensus records were assessed in this run.")
  } else {
    assessed_wide <- assessed_df |>
      mutate(
        cell = paste0(
          round(as.numeric(pct_identity), 1), "% (", aligned_bp, " bp)",
          ifelse(tolower(reverse_complemented) %in% c("yes", "true"), " [rc]", "")
        )
      ) |>
      select(sample, gene, cell) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = gene, values_from = cell, values_fill = "not assessed") |>
      rename(Sample = sample)

    assessed_gt <- assessed_wide |> gt() |>
      tab_options(table.font.size = "90%")
  }
}
if (exists("assessed_gt")) assessed_gt
```

`r if (exists("is_fasta") && is_fasta) "Values show alignment identity and aligned length; [rc] marks records that were reverse-complemented to match the reference orientation. \"not assessed\" means no consensus record was supplied for that gene." else ""`

## Key Mutation Summary Across All Samples

```{r}
resistance_files <- list.files(
    pattern="\\.resistance\\.tsv$"
)

resistance_df <- resistance_files |>
    purrr::map_dfr(
        ~read_tsv(
            .x,
            col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
        ) |>
        mutate(
            Sample = tools::file_path_sans_ext(
                tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(.x))
            )
        )
    )


if(nrow(resistance_df)==0){
  cat("No characterised resistance mutations were detected.")
} else {
  # The phenotype database is already in long format (one row per
  # Gene_Mutation / Drug) with a pre-computed EC50_ratio (rounded to 2 dp by
  # db_matching.py) and Level_of_resistance, so no per-study averaging is done
  # here - we just tidy and collapse to one row per Gene/Mutation/Drug.
  levels <- c("Susceptible", "Low", "Medium", "High")

  format_level <- function(x){

    x <- factor(na.omit(x), levels = levels, ordered = TRUE)

    if(length(x) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    lo <- min(x)
    hi <- max(x)

    if(lo == hi)
      as.character(lo)
    else
      paste0(lo, "–", hi)
  }

  format_ec50 <- function(x){

    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
    nums <- sort(nums[!is.na(nums)])

    if(length(nums) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    fmt <- function(v) format(round(v, 2), trim = TRUE, nsmall = 0)

    if(min(nums) == max(nums))
      fmt(min(nums))
    else
      sprintf("%s–%s", fmt(min(nums)), fmt(max(nums)))
  }

  format_refs <- function(x){

    keys <- unlist(strsplit(paste(stats::na.omit(x), collapse = ", "), ",\\s*"))
    keys <- unique(trimws(keys))
    keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & keys != "" & keys != "NA"]

    if(length(keys) == 0)
      return(NA_character_)

    paste0("[@", keys, "]", collapse = "; ")
  }

  # Collapse to the worst confidence tier present in the group - this table
  # aggregates across every sample in the run, so highlight risk rather than
  # hide it if any one detection was low-confidence. "N/A" (FASTA input) is
  # excluded unless it's all there is.
  confidence_levels <- c("Low", "Medium", "High")

  format_confidence <- function(x){
    x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "N/A"]
    if(length(x) == 0)
      return("N/A")
    as.character(min(factor(x, levels = confidence_levels, ordered = TRUE)))
  }

  # Prefer exact single-mutation database entries; only fall back to compound
  # (combination-mutation) entries for a Gene/Mutation/Drug with no exact match.
  resis_use <- resistance_df |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    filter(if(any(match_type == "exact")) match_type == "exact" else TRUE) |>
    ungroup()

  summary_df <- resis_use |>
    group_by(Gene, Mutation, Drug) |>
    summarise(
      `EC50 ratio` = format_ec50(EC50_ratio),
      `Level of resistance` = format_level(Level_of_resistance),
      Reference = format_refs(References),
      Confidence = format_confidence(confidence),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  level_order <- c(
    "Unknown",
    "Susceptible",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High"
  )

  highest_level <- function(x) {

    if (is.na(x) || x == "")
      return("Unknown")

    # Split ranges like "Low–Medium"
    levs <- unlist(strsplit(x, "–"))

    levs <- factor(levs,
                  levels = level_order,
                  ordered = TRUE)

    as.character(max(levs))
  }

  summary_table <- summary_df

  summary_table$Drug <- factor(
    summary_table$Drug,
    levels = c(
      "Ganciclovir",
      "Foscarnet",
      "Cidofovir",
      "Maribavir",
      "Letermovir"
    )
  )

  summary_table <-
    summary_table |>
    mutate(Resistance = vapply(`Level of resistance`, highest_level, character(1))) |>
    select(Gene, Mutation, Confidence, Drug, Resistance) |>
    distinct() |>
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Drug,
      values_from = Resistance,
      names_expand = TRUE,
      values_fill = "Unknown"
    ) |>
    select(
      Gene,
      Mutation,
      # Confidence is only meaningful for read (FASTQ) input - FASTA/Sanger
      # calls are always "N/A", so drop it there.
      any_of(if (!is_fasta) "Confidence" else character(0)),
      Ganciclovir,
      Foscarnet,
      Cidofovir,
      Maribavir,
      Letermovir
    )

  legend <- HTML(
    paste(
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#A9A9A9;border:1px solid black;'></span> Unknown (not found in database)",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#00FF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Susceptible (< 2 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFFF00;border:1px solid black;'></span> Low (>= 2 & < 5 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FFA500;border:1px solid black;'></span> Medium (>= 5 & < 15 EC50 ratio)",
      "&nbsp;&nbsp;",
      "<span style='display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;background:#FF0000;border:1px solid black;'></span> High (>= 15 EC50 ratio)"
      )
    )

  tbl <- gt(summary_table)
  tbl <- tbl |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Ganciclovir,
        rows = Ganciclovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Foscarnet,
        rows = Foscarnet == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Cidofovir,
        rows = Cidofovir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Maribavir,
        rows = Maribavir == "High"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "#A9A9A9"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Unknown"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "green"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Susceptible"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "yellow"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Low"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "orange"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "Medium"
      )
    ) |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_fill(color = "red"),
      locations = cells_body(
        columns = Letermovir,
        rows = Letermovir == "High"
      )
    )

  if (!is_fasta) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      opt_footnote_marks(marks = "standard") |>
      tab_style(
        style = list(cell_fill(color = "#FFB6C1"), cell_text(weight = "bold")),
        locations = cells_body(columns = Confidence, rows = Confidence == "Low")
      ) |>
      tab_style(
        style = cell_fill(color = "#FFF3B0"),
        locations = cells_body(columns = Confidence, rows = Confidence == "Medium")
      ) |>
      tab_footnote(
        footnote = confidence_footnote_text,
        locations = cells_column_labels(columns = Confidence)
      )
  }

  tbl <- tbl |> tab_source_note(source_note = legend)

  tbl
}
```
